rca of the issue: N/A — the late-payment bug fix described in the request is correctly implemented. Idempotent _mark_paid atomically approves the order, and when reservation_active is false at approval time the order is flagged needs_stock_review=true + fulfillment_status='revisao_estoque'. Admin /admin/orders/{id}/resolve-stock enforces the pending-review + approved invariants and either performs a transactional stock reservation+convert (returning 409 on insufficient stock, with rollback of already-reserved items) or marks refunded/cancelled. All 4 branches (mark-review, fulfill-ok, fulfill-409, refund) covered by test_iteration3.py.
